availability.evidence: docs/research/s3c-sameday-ops-1349/availability.json, written by `scripts/s3c_sameday_ops_1349.py availability` from the tracked snapshots (tests/fixtures/snapshots/on_rrp_inputs/nyfed_on_rrp and tests/fixtures/snapshots/srf_inputs/nyfed_srf) and committed before any score. The Desk's own data are the evidence: each operation record states its close time (closeTime) and the time it was last written (lastUpdated). The Desk states no publication clock time for its results.
availability.rule: a date's figure is public at the decision instant of its own day when the latest lastUpdated of the records it sums is at or before 18:00 New York on that day. A record cannot have been first written later than its last write, and the API is assumed to serve a record from the time it is written (not verifiable from outside; the same assumption as nyfed_on_rrp_sameday and nyfed_repo_ops_sameday). A date written after the instant, or rewritten later (first publication not visible), is withheld and reads as no take-up, which is how fed_liquidity reads a withheld date.
availability.sources_used: both. The ruling: if either is not reliably out by 18:00, use only the one that is. The evidence file records, for each of ON RRP and the SRF, the share of operation dates public by 18:00 on their own day, the hours of the last writes and the margin of the closest one to the instant; the sources are used when that share is 99% or more. The result is stated on the page and in availability.json (`used`).
availability.not_changed: metadata/sources.json and metadata/sources_measurement.json are not edited: nyfed_repo_ops_sameday (16:00) and nyfed_on_rrp_sameday (15:00) stay as declared and off in every published declaration; the 18:00 reading is a development reading made by repo_model.same_day_operations.

candidates.name: sc_s3c_ann_net_sameday
candidates.label: (s3c-ann-net-sameday)
candidates.definition: (s3c-ann-net) of #1288 (the announced net settlement per leg, in USD 100 bn, scarcity state held at its maximum; repo_model.s3c_announced.ANN_NET_ARM) with three extra terms of the decision day D = T - h, read at every lead h = 1..5: srf_flag, 1 when the overnight Standing Repo Facility take-up on D is above zero; srf_size, that take-up in units of USD 100 bn; on_rrp_change, the ON RRP amount accepted on D less that on the previous panel day, in units of USD 100 bn. A term enters a lead's fit when at least three training pairs carry it non-zero. Everything else is (s3)'s: the other terms, the Huber fit (k = 1.345), the ridge of 5, the pool of standardised residuals and the direct pairs; the SRF cap at the line from full allotment, margin 0 bp, is applied to its quantiles exactly as to (s3)'s (repo_model.s3c_candidate, unchanged).
candidates.module: repo_model.same_day_operations (SAMEDAY_ARM = ANN_NET_ARM with extra = OPS_EXTRAS; SameDayOperationTerms is the table walk reads through its iorb argument); the fit is repo_model.spread_mr_state_calendar's with its extra terms generalised to the three names (OPS_EXTRAS, EXTRA_TERMS); no behaviour of an existing arm changes
candidates.units: srf_flag: 0/1; srf_size, on_rrp_change: USD 100 bn (a USD 25 bn take-up reads 0.25; the sign of the ON RRP change is kept); effect reported in bp per flagged day and bp per USD 100 bn

new_read.what: the Desk's own operation results for the decision day: the overnight SRF take-up (the operations and amount of ingest._nyfed_srf_rows) and the ON RRP amount accepted (the sum of ingest._nyfed_on_rrp_rows)
new_read.leakage_boundary: repo_model.same_day_operations.SameDayOperationTerms.read re-derives the three terms from the day figures at the decision instant and compares them with the figures the table serves: a figure that counts a record last written after the instant raises LookAheadError, one that leaves a public record out raises StaleReadError. tests/test_same_day_operations_1349.py holds the leakage test with one recorded mutation (the instant of the figure taken from the target day instead of the decision day; LookAheadError). A training figure and a forecast figure are the same function of the same records (at(lead, row) equals read(lead, row - lead)).
new_read.not_read_elsewhere: no published declaration, record or live path reads it

pairs: direct: the terms are a state of the decision day read at the decision, and the fit trains on direct pairs with training_pairs = 'direct' (spread_mr_state_calendar.fit_state_terms is guarded by one_step_guard with no allow-list entry; repo_model.one_step_guard.ONE_STEP_ALLOW_LIST is not changed); the provisional-register row is metadata/provisional/cleared/s3c_sameday_ops_1349.json

frame.windows: the two windows of #1255, loaded as #1255 loads them: the development window (decision days whose five targets fall on or before 2025-12-31) and the 2026 development days (decision days whose five targets fall from 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-03, the near-blind tier open since GO #151). The 2026 days are reported on their own, as a window
frame.walk: (s3) is #1145's walk (refit every 21 decision days, direct pairs); every walk of this study starts on the same first decision day and runs over the same decision days as #1255's, so the arms are compared on the same days. The study refuses to write a record unless every scored decision day has a forecast of every model
frame.guards: a scored decision day or target day passes lockbox.require_unlocked through spread_mean_reversion_686.require_scored_days with the last day of the window; the blind tier (from 2026-09-04) and every lockbox day are refused; the operation tables are read only for panel dates, which end at the last unlocked day

primary.metric: grid CRPS (23 levels) averaged over leads h = 1..5
primary.pressure_probability: the Brier score of P(spread > +5 bp), the probability read off the 23 quantiles as 1 - F(floor(tau) + 0.5), F linear between them (spread_mean_reversion.exceedance), the event strict and on whole basis points (data.exceeds_bp)
primary.calibration: the coverage of the central 90% band (q5 to q95, closed) of every model, pooled and by regime; a rate, reported as a mean and not tested
primary.comparisons: the arm against (s3c-ann-net) (the candidate) and against (s3c), paired; the benchmarks B1, B1' and B2 are not part of this directive's comparisons and are not re-scored here

scoring.scorer: repo_model.scoring_protocol (#655), the development tier: no verdict, no registration
scoring.test: scoring_protocol.paired_tests, the studentized stationary bootstrap (ruling 1), mean block 10 business days, 10,000 draws, seed 1349, two-sided 90% interval (the lower end is the one-sided 95% bound); the skill interval and the studentized interval on mean d are reported for every tested row; where the studentized bound cannot be computed the unstudentized percentile interval of mean d is given beside it, with no reading taken from it
scoring.reading: a reading is taken from the mean-d bound (her ruling on #1009): the arm is read better than a reference when the lower end of the 90% interval of mean d is above zero, worse when the upper end is below zero, otherwise undecided. Lens C's caveat (the lag-10 HAC standard error is understated about 2x after 2020) is stated on the page
scoring.splits: pooled; by lead; by regime (the declared regimes, 2018-19 and 2020 on their own among them); by pressure-day type of the target day (turn_days.reporting_day_type, the record in force); by the decision day's own take-up (SRF take-up above zero or not; the ON RRP amount moved by USD 10 bn or more or not). The 2026 development days are the second window and carry the same splits. The intervals of a group of days keep the current method (the group's days, scattered, resampled in date order as if consecutive), which #1221 questions and #1228 will decide
scoring.identical_groups: a group in which the arm's score equals the reference's on every day is listed as identical and not tested against it; a group of fewer than 20 days is listed and not tested

reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the candidate of avenue #1318 and (s3c) the H5 candidate until she rules.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the lead, regime and take-up splits beside it.

Whether the same-day reading enters a published declaration, or the arm goes back to her as a candidate, is a marked question with numbered options and a default that changes no claim; the registry is not changed in this directive.
